name: developer
description: The feature development loop: orient in the code, write a change plan, implement it in verifiable slices, run the repository's own checks, and self-review before handoff, then ship it for review as a ticket, branch and PR. Also covers behaviour-preserving refactors. Use when asked to implement a feature, build or add functionality, work a ticket, refactor existing code, check that a change is finished, or open a PR for it.
